General Motors is an automotive company focused on advancing safer and more sustainable transportation. The Software Engineer, Simulation will design and maintain software for internal test creation platforms, automate simulation test execution across local and cloud infrastructure, develop tools for machine learning-based systems, and analyze simulation failures to improve model performance and autonomous vehicle safety.
Automotive

H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain software components for internal test creation platforms (ScenarioKit)
Build and maintain automated pipelines for the execution of simulation tests across local and cloud-based (GCP) infrastructure
Develop tools and scripts to facilitate the testing of Machine Learning (ML) based perception and planning systems
Analyze simulation failure cases to support the continuous improvement of model performance and AV safety
100% telecommuting permitted

Required

One (1) year of experience with: Python and C++ for software development and Automation
One (1) year of experience with: Designing, developing, and validating of simulation environments, robotics systems, or autonomous system software
One (1) year of experience with: SQL or similar database querying tools, and data processing in large-scale computing environments
One (1) year of experience with: Machine Learning models and Computer Vision systems
One (1) year of experience with: Cloud-based development environments for scalable software execution
Benefits
100% telecommuting permitted.
Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance.
